independence_evidence: Self-published by a small Norwich-based team (about page lists co-founders and staff; contact page gives 25 St John Maddermarket, Norwich); copyright © 2026 Glory; no media-group owner.
qualifies_reason: Independent UK football-travel title with print editions in 2025 (Hamburg City Stories, Hibernian Club Edition) and 2026 (Colorado Rapids, Mexico Country Edition No. 12) sold on its own site.
what_it_is: A UK football magazine that treats each issue as a travel document about one country, city or club, away from the big leagues: recent editions cover San Marino, Hamburg, Hibernian and, for the 2026 World Cup, Mexico. Issues run to around 200-240 pages of film photography from stadiums and streets, long essays, interviews and practical notes for visiting. It suits readers who like football for its fan culture and places rather than results, and travel readers who use the game as a way in.
